style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and detail grids, pale sky #CFE4F1 for claim and spec panels, deep slate #22455C for the closing flat lay
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and straight ray arrows in the accent tint, flat, no 3D, no glossy badges
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card; outdoor shots run a hard 6000K coastal key with unseen bounce; texture revealed only with skimming light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool daylight sport-apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale sky blue #CFE4F1, deep slate #22455C and one warm sun accent #E9A63C; bright high-key studio lighting from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card, hard 6000K coastal key only in the outdoor scene, skimming light only for fabric texture; modern geometric sans-serif with headline and short label slots kept as placeholders; thin single-weight line icon style with flat straight ray arrows; real fabric drape with visible topstitch and matte finish; stable slight 3/4 worn angle with hood and front zipper always readable; generous negative space reserved for copy; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no rating numbers or index badges, no identifiable faces.
noDrift: no rating numbers, index badges or percentage marks
no identifiable model faces or retouched skin
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 worn angle and always-visible hood and front zipper; garment never hidden by props; no identifiable face in any frame; fabric kept matte with visible topstitch
style.surfaceSystem: pale sand #E8DCC6 underfoot in the lifestyle scene, matte white seamless floor elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one headline slot plus two or three short label slots, every rendered word carried by a placeholder
